model: Toscano FI SRAM Rival XPLR AXS E1 13 Spd
description: Toscano FI : Exceptional. Every Time. Everywhere. The experience of sublime power and speed on gravel is easy to identify, but oh-so difficult to attain. It’s that pursuit of perfection—a smooth interface with the road, a powerful procession over gravel— that makes for the best ride you’ve ever experienced on two wheels. Now, add clean, fully internal cable integration, and you’ve achieved something special: the best-performance gravel ride, with the cleanest aero presentation available anywhere. Welcome to gravel nirvana. Introducing the Toscano FI. The Inspiration Compared to other road and gravel races, there’s something quite elegant and special about the Strade Bianche, a rite of spring that takes place in central Italy in Tuscany for a race that hearkens to the golden age of cycling, when events took place on the gravel roads around them. Strade Bianche (or “white roads”) sees over 60 kilometers of the annual race taking place on white gravel roads lined with tall cypress trees, rewarding not just the fittest, but the most skilled on all terrain. In the Toscano region, legend is earned. And we built the Litespeed Toscano in that spirit. Cutting Edge Titanium Technology We take some of the finest elements of our flagship road bike—the Spezia—and apply them to a bike built for speed on any surface—then clear out all the wires and cables for a clean aero presentation. That means titanium tube designs that are all primed to provide unsurpassed levels of performance as well as reduced weight. The Toscano’s tubes all get premium treatment; with diameters adjusted and wall thicknesses measured to meet our exacting tolerance and weight standards, and adjusted for consistency. The Toscano also features an externally-butted headtube and bottom bracket for weight savings and plenty of performance-focused tube shaping throughout the frame. The Toscano applies one of Litespeed’s hallmark technical advances: a 6AL/4V titanium sheet-formed top tube. Painstakingly handcrafted from a flat sheet into a multiform tubeset, this special top tube is not just visually striking. The unique mix of our tube construction with one of the highest tensile varietals of titanium is not only lighter than a standard tubeset, but its high tensile properties also yield a high degree of stiffness, for increased rigidity. The toptube is paired with a triaxially aero-shaped 3AL/2.5V downtube, shaped to shroud the downtube bottle for a touch of aero effect when powering solo, on-road, or off. The Toscano’s rear triangle is sublime in its look, but devious in its performance. Much of the attention can be focused on the seatstay interface with the 6AL/4V top tube; the stays not only connect with one of the stiffest toptubes in titanium, but they also retain a wide stance for new levels of torsional stiffness throughout the rear triangle of the Toscano. A dropped drive-side chainstay provides up to 48mm of tire clearance, providing plenty of footing options on any type of terrain from fast file tread to big lugs for grip on loose or wet terrain. The Toscano also features a UDH (Universal Derailleur Hanger) interface. The pièce de résistance is full cable integration on Toscano FI. This premium “FI” (Fully Integrated) build is our cleanest, most aero setup, with all brake and shift wire routed within the handlebar, stem, headset, and fork and out in the wind, around a T47i bottom bracket. Within the Toscano FI range, we present two incredible options. Select from our premium Toscano FI build featuring ENVE’s IN-Route system, with Chris King’s Aeroset 3 headset, ENVE's IN-Route carbon fork, and carbon handlebar. Or choose our standard Toscano FI build, with Litespeed’s own carbon FI fork, paired with FSA’s fully integrated ACR stem and handlebar. Whichever you choose, the Toscano FI exists as the finest, cleanest, most aero presentation in gravel riding. The ride is a marked difference from what you'd expect.
